text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh!! Buena-san really is 
incredible...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I have to run alongside her— I 
have to hold on tight!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(A circle that extends beyond the 
racetrack cannot be formed!)

text_block_list.name: Pisa & Buena
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!! 
Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!
(UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"I can't stop getting goosebumps!" "Buena! 
Pisa!" "The fierce battle between those 
two was the absolute best...!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Aah—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...! ...I gave it... everything I had...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Still, ah— they stole the show right from 
under us..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Pisa-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um, I just had to tell you. Today was 
truly... magnificent.

Buena Vista enveloped Victoire Pisa's 
hands within her own.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
While running, I could feel your burning 
passion so intensely it made my skin 
prickle...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though every single bit of those 
feelings was delivered straight to the 
stands!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san— Is the Arima Kinen up next for 
you?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...! In that case, let's 
create even more wonderful, breathtaking 
sights together!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I know that together, we can put on a race 
that's truly thrilling and from the bottom 
of our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
An Arima Kinen that reaches the stands... 
and even far beyond them...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a promise...

In the middle of the turf, the two linked 
pinkies— as roaring cheers and thunderous 
applause enveloped them.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can finally catch my breath 
a bit.
choice_data_list: Yeah, thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...I am truly glad I 
was able to accomplish what needed to be 
done.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, the finish line isn't here. What 
I must do... is weave a circle that 
reaches far beyond the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It is about creating an emotional impact 
that reaches the hearts of those who have 
left the racecourse as well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
... I will definitely make it happen at 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Just one more push, together. Will you do 
your best with me, Trainer?"

On the way home from having that meal— I 
saw an Umamusume running along the 
riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Pisa—and Trainer. Fancy meeting you here.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...Training, is it?"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I guess I just got a little ahead of 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen will be here in the blink 
of an eye, won't it? I'd be delighted if 
we could spend it together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I know very well how Rose-san runs. That 
is precisely why... she must be on that 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"It all comes down to the fan vote, after 
all. Still, I feel the exact same way."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Watching you run today convinced me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Defeating you in the upcoming Arima Kinen. 
That is currently the greatest proof of 
strength to lead my clan to nationhood.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: You flatter me with such kind words.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Do not be so modest. You are now one of 
the Umamusume carrying this era upon your 
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, see you later. Let's meet 
at the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Because everyone is here, I can become 
stronger. I'm... truly fortunate, aren't 
I?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Arima Kinen"— Let us make it a truly 
wonderful race.

The cold winter night breeze grazes my 
cheek.

"The year-end Grand Prix carrying 
everyone's hopes, the Arima Kinen, is just 
around the corner."
